lines.text: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Stay

notes: Small sign in the middle of a lawn; occupies a small part of the frame. The bottom line is a row of greetings in local languages separated by bullets (appears to be 'RAN ANNIM • KASELEHLIE • MOGETHIN • PAING KOWOS' as on the Pohnpei sign) but is too small to read reliably, so it is not transcribed. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: Capital of the Federated States of Micronesia
KASELEHLIE • RAN ANNIM • MOGETHIN • PAING KOWOS

notes: Terminal name board, slightly angled. The last line is 'welcome/greeting' words in Pohnpeian, Chuukese, Yapese and Kosraean, separated by bullets. Distractors: 'Continental Micronesia SORRY NO TRANSITING PASSENGERS BEYOND THIS POINT' sandwich board, blue immigration notice (English/Japanese) over the door. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Brown name board in front of the terminal, partly hidden by shrubs (leaves cross INTERNATIONAL and AIRPORT; the rest of the 'Welcome ...' line is hidden). The painted board on the roof reads 'WELCOME TO KOSRAE' / 'THE MYSTERIOUS PARADISE ISLAND' / 'HOME OF THE SLEEPING LADY MOUNTAIN' (plus tiny illegible text); it is a second, fully legible target. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
